closes: Independent oracle proves the report-packager release predicate is a minimal irredundant strict conjunction of 4 gates (unique accept 1/16, 15 fail-closed), monotone fail-closed (0/all ordered-pair violations), with all 4 gates necessary, and that the authority-lock semantics are non-escalating (meet=GLB over the tier chain; join counter-model escalates; packaging path emits authority_lock_present exactly once and always false). 4 adversarial mutants all caught.
does_not_close: Does not promote the module, flip scientific_readiness, run the Rust runtime, provide the missing signed score envelopes / report package, or certify any release gate true -- that needs the authorized Phase-1 pipeline and human dual-identity keys. Models the tier chain and packaging map from published lattice theory and observed source semantics; it is a structural proof, not legal/regulatory adjudication.
hypothesis: The runtime honestly quarantines (all four release gates false) because inputs are absent; the release DECISION FUNCTION is a minimal strict-AND with a single accepting configuration, is antitone (no gate downgrade can upgrade the decision), and its authority-lock invariant is non-escalating -- so packaging can never strip locks or amplify a claim.
non_circularity: Pure CPython; no import of the Rust runtime. Gate set and the authority_lock_present structural invariant read from primary lib.rs bytes; algebraic properties proved by exhaustive 2^4 / 16x16 / tier-pair enumeration; theory anchors are published standards.
purpose: Independently prove the report-packager signed-deliverable-quarantine release predicate is a minimal (irredundant) strict conjunction of four gates with a unique accept, is monotone fail-closed, and that its authority-lock semantics are non-escalating (lattice meet / most-restrictive-controls), with the packaging path structurally unable to emit authority_lock_present=true.
